shortBio.en: Black Sabbath guitarist; downtuned power-chord riff grammar that metal later treats as default.
shortBio.zh: Black Sabbath 吉他手；降调 power-chord riff 语法，后被金属当作默认。

whyHub.en: Constant across Ozzy, Dio, and reunion Sabbath: finger injury → lighter strings → heavy riff as institutional spine.
whyHub.zh: 贯穿 Ozzy、Dio 与重聚 Sabbath 的常量：手指伤 → 更细弦 → 重 riff 作为制度脊梁。

body.en:
Born 1948, Birmingham. Industrial accident cost fingertips; lighter gauge and downtuning feed Paranoid-era riffs (Iron Man, War Pigs). Ozzy-era Sabbath (1970–78) sets the citation albums; Dio-era Heaven and Hell (1980) keeps Iommi’s riff center under a different singer.

Hub is continuity: vocalists and eras change; the guitar method does not. Late reunions still cite the same tritone/power-chord vocabulary.
body.zh:
1948 年生于伯明翰。工业事故伤指尖；更细弦与降调喂出 Paranoid 时期 riff（Iron Man、War Pigs）。Ozzy 时期 Sabbath（1970–78）是引用专集；Dio 时期 Heaven and Hell（1980）在换主唱下仍以 Iommi riff 为中心。

枢纽是连续性：主唱与时代变，吉他方法不变。后期重聚仍引用同一三全音/power-chord 词汇。

note.en: Founding guitar through Ozzy, Dio, and late reunion eras.
note.zh: 创始吉他，贯穿 Ozzy、Dio 与后期重聚。
